tess-marketing: Quick ask for tomorrow's launch rehearsal 1: can runtime run a tiny 'sparkprobe' to validate coldstart consistency across 3 payload sizes? Need artifacts by 08:15 PT.

omar-runtime: We can do that. Specs? model pair and requests count?

tess-marketing: Run redwood-mini-6b fp16 and mini-6b-q4 fallback. 30 requests total (10 short/10 med/10 long). Baseline: no KV cache. Also one small cached comparison. Include latencies.csv, p50/p90/p99, coldstart heatmap, and a logits snapshot for one long request. Sample traces for p95+.

izzy-ops: Heads up: maintenance window 03:00-04:00 PT on shared pool. Recommend slot at 06:00 PT.

omar-runtime: Scheduled 06:00 PT baseline (run id sp-1799001120), 06:40 PT cached run (sp-1799001128). Concurrency capped at 3.

bench-bot: sp-1799001120 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/sp-1799001120/sparkprobe.tar.gz

tess-marketing: Got it. One long-case p99 spike at req-088; please attach trace and logits and a quick note.

omar-runtime: traces/req-088.json and snapshots/logits-req-088.npy.gz included. Note: spike aligned with a transient kernel scheduling noise on host gpu-dedicated-2 during first-token; re-run on gpu-dedicated-6 did not reproduce.

tess-marketing: Perfect. Pasteable 3-bullet summary please?

omar-runtime: "Sparkprobe (n=30 across short/med/long) for redwood-mini-6b (fp16) and q4 fallback. Artifacts: per-request latencies, percentile summary, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces, and a logits snapshot for a long outlier. Observed one p99 tied to host scheduler noise on gpu-dedicated-2; not reproducible on gpu-dedicated-6. Recommendation: reserve gpu-dedicated-6 for rehearsal."

tess-marketing: Exactly what we need 1: thanks all :rocket:
